atlas_brief.greeting: Good evening, James. It is 16:14 Adelaide on Monday 10 August 2026.
atlas_brief.body: Today was a major governance and campaign operations day. RE-ENG-AUG-2026 was sent to 147 production recipients at 9AM. Six recipients received duplicate sends (identified, root-caused, remediated). The campaign response infrastructure had a critical gap at launch (Campaign Tokens table was never provisioned, all 441 YES/NO/UNSUBSCRIBE links initially returned errors). Recovered by 5PM. The incident triggered a complete governance overhaul: Production Artifact Lock, Central Send Boundary with execution authority gate, Principle of Least Authority applied across all 29 active automations, and 12-gate Pre-Execution Certification. QPaint pipeline remains healthy at $5.39M. RE-ENG-AUG-2026 is now MONITOR ONLY, zero YES clicks as of evening.

business_knowledge.description: Permanent business principles from completed experiments and customer interactions.

principles.principle: Painters do not respond meaningfully to curiosity-led outreach about quote follow-up.
Trust and shared experience are stronger opening mechanisms than curiosity for trade business owners.
principles.evidence: Curiosity-led = 0 replies. FF1 launched as hypothesis.

principles.principle: Customers do not buy because we follow up. They buy because they become more confident.
Never trust a green tick. Every claim of external effect must be independently verified.
principles.evidence: 172 emails reported sent, 0 in Gmail Sent folder.

principles.principle: When a customer is waiting on a third party, remove the burden from them. Offer to check back.
principles.evidence: Customer stuck on insurer. 2-week check-in offered.

principles.principle: A lost job is not necessarily a lost customer. Thank them, preserve the relationship, leave the door open.
principles.evidence: Previous client lost on cost. Graceful close preserved relationship.

principles.principle: When the business has let a customer down, acknowledge it honestly. No excuses.
principles.evidence: Customer lost to delayed follow-up. Honest apology preserved goodwill.

principles.principle: Operational Ownership: Atlas never performs work that belongs to the client.
principles.evidence: Won deal. Client owns scheduling; Atlas owns customer care.

principles.principle: Acknowledge Before Handover. Customers should never wonder whether their email was received.
principles.evidence: Acknowledge, reassure, hand over. Not silence.

principles.principle: The Cost of Stopping Is Always Lower Than the Cost of Assuming.
principles.evidence: 172 undelivered + 32 false Email 2. 60-second verification would have prevented both.

principles.principle: Production Environments Must Prove They Are Healthy Before Operating.
principles.evidence: Two incidents from environment operating unverified. Production Readiness Check now mandatory.

principles.principle: Intelligence Escalation Framework: Escalate based on operational importance, not curiosity.
principles.source: Janis Tham / Civium, refined by James, Aug 2026

principles.principle: Reality Always Wins: The CRM must represent reality such that James never needs Gmail to understand state.
Expected Execution Is Not Verified Execution. PASS requires read-back evidence that the artefact exists.
principles.evidence: 4 emails sent but Messages missing. Workflow reported PASS on expectation, not evidence.

principles.principle: Gmail Sent Is Communication Truth. Only independent Gmail evidence proves customer communication occurred.
principles.evidence: 3 production incidents where API/script/Airtable diverged from Gmail reality.

production_incidents.description: Every incident strengthens the operating system.

recent.title: FF1 Wave 1 — 16 Duplicate Email 1 Sends
recent.root_cause: Blind batch re-run with no duplicate-send prevention
recent.resolution: 2-layer duplicate prevention (pre-send + state-transition). FF1 marked experimentally contaminated.
recent.learning: Retry must filter to eligible only. Never resend full batch.

recent.title: 32 QPaint Email 2 — Zero Delivered, Airtable Advanced
recent.root_cause: Proof-before-Progress was documentation, not architectural control. Airtable advanced without Gmail verification.
recent.resolution: Canonical state-transition authority installed. 5 bypass scripts disabled. Invariant: NO GMAIL = NO ADVANCE.
recent.learning: When a failure mode recurs after being 'fixed,' the fix was not architectural. Make it architectural.

recent.title: atlas@ Lacked gmail.send — QPaint Replies Undelivered

recent.resolution: Production Readiness Check standard. Token re-authorised.
recent.learning: Never trust send success. Verify token scopes before production.
